fullPassage: Paradoxically, it's uncertainty that makes us feel most alive. Think of events that shake you out of your everyday routine: maybe attending a family wedding, making a big presentation, or going somewhere you've never been. It's on those occasions that time seems to slow down a little, and you feel more fully engaged. The same holds true if the experience is risky, like mountain climbing or parasailing. Your senses are sharper. You notice more. Thanks to the release of a feel-good chemical in the brain called dopamine, you get a greater rush of pleasure from chance encounters with people than planned meetings. Good news, financial rewards, and gifts are more enjoyable if they are surprises. It's why the most popular television shows and movies are the ones with unexpected plot twists and astonishing endings.

questions.passage: Paradoxically, it's uncertainty that makes us feel most alive. Think of events that shake you out of your everyday routine: maybe attending a family wedding, making a big presentation, or going somewhere you've never been. It's on those occasions that time seems to slow down a little, and you feel more fully engaged. The same holds true if the experience is risky, like mountain climbing or parasailing. Your senses are sharper. You notice more. Thanks to the release of a feel-good chemical in the brain called dopamine, you get a greater rush of pleasure from chance encounters with people than planned meetings. Good news, financial rewards, and gifts are more enjoyable if they are surprises. It's why the most popular television shows and movies are the ones with unexpected plot twists and astonishing endings.

det.korean: The same holds true if the experience is risky
det.analysis:
'똑같이 적용된다'는 'The same holds true(똑같은 것이 참이다 = 마찬가지다)'라는 표현으로 시작해요: The(그) + same(똑같은 것) + holds(유지한다) + true(참인).

'그 경험이 위험할 때도(~라면)'는 조건절 if로 이어요: if(만약) + the(그) + experience(경험) + is(이다) + risky(위험한).

순서대로 놓으면 The / same / holds / true / if / the / experience / is / risky → 'The same holds true if the experience is risky'.
det.tip: The same holds true = 마찬가지다 / if + 주어 + is ~ = ~이 …라면
